description: Place an outbound phone call to a business to ask for information on a named person’s behalf. Use it when find_business_agent returned not_found for a US or Canadian number; when a Direct card exists use send_to_business. It dials a real number and a call cannot be recalled once placed. Requires direct:tasks, human opt-in at https://odilelabs.com/developers#voice and the person’s permission for this call (on_behalf_consent true). Informational calls only: no sales, payments or account access. Calls run Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 in the business’s local time; outside that window the request is refused and the error includes next_window. A number is not called twice within 24 hours, and each account has a daily call cap. number and callback_number must be callable US or Canadian E.164 numbers, callback_number being the person’s own, never the business’s. message_id is required: reuse it unchanged on every retry so only one call is placed. Returns {task_id, state (queued, completed or failed), status}; read get_call_result for progress and answers. Voice credit costs: get_m2m_network.

callback_number.description: That person’s own callback number in E.164, never the business’s.

caller_name.description: The named person who requested this call.

max_seconds.description: Maximum call duration, from 60 to 600 seconds, subject to available credits.

message_id.description: A stable request id; reuse it unchanged on every retry.

need.description: The information the person wants from the business.

number.description: The business’s E.164 phone number, e.g. +15615550123.

on_behalf_consent.description: True only after that person asked for this call.

questions.description: Up to five questions to ask the business.

name: call_business
title: Call a business without a Direct card
